entries.subject: NOIRLab noao-ngc6946kpno (Mayall 4-meter Mosaic)
entries.finding: The disc to 17.5 kpc in eight filters, 23.6 arcmin wide at 0.26 arcsec per pixel; the page's registration matches Gaia stars to a pixel.

entries.subject: Gemini GMOS (noao-ngc6946), Pan-STARRS DR1, DESI Legacy Surveys
entries.finding: The Gemini image covers 5.8 x 5.6 arcmin, the inner disc only. Pan-STARRS subtracts the disc's faint light as sky, leaving dark patches between the arms. The Legacy Surveys do not cover this field, 12 degrees from the Galactic plane.

entries.subject: S4G bulge-plus-disc fit (Salo et al. 2015)
entries.finding: CDS J/ApJS/219/4 table7 has no row for NGC 6946: the survey kept to Galactic latitudes above 30 degrees. The scale length is Leroy et al.'s (2008).
